description: ALB Listener TLS Policy Allows Deprecated Protocols
rationale: A listener TLS policy permitting TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1 falls below the TLS 1.2 minimum in this versioned protocol profile. Known TLS 1.2/1.3-only policies do not trigger this control; unknown policies or missing TLS evidence are incomplete rather than presumed secure. Cipher-suite strength, FIPS and PQ suitability are outside this protocol-floor check.
